scope_warning: These are counterexamples to auxiliary proof compressions, not to H_ceil(n/2)>=(mu/2)A^-1.

incremental_gain_barrier.conclusion: The first two leading minors are positive and the determinant is negative, so Delta_2-(mu/3)A^-1 has exactly one negative eigenvalue.

scalar_child_half_barrier.geometry: direct sum of a signed-rank-one 2-block and a simplex 3-block
scalar_child_half_barrier.scope: This refutes scalarizing the dimension-four child certificates; the exact lifted J2 child matrices have large positive surplus.

volume_only_barrier.scope: The exact prefix can still satisfy the target; determinant-weighted subset projectors alone discard the essential order variance.

local_subset_polynomial_barrier.scope: This kills a local-subset shortcut whose average spectral proxy would imply W3.  It does not refute W3 itself; the proxy has additional trace-floor slack relative to the true target.

iterated_row_square_barrier.failed_claim: The twice row-square-compressed lower state already proves C3 >= (2mu/m)A^-1.
iterated_row_square_barrier.scope: The exact uncompressed lifted square has positive anisotropic surplus.  Reapplying the same row-Cauchy compression discards enough of it to miss W3 for every m>3 near the rank-one boundary. It clears the weaker 3/(2m) target by only 1/[m(m-1)] in the limit.
